capabilities: Render timelines from plain-text code blocks in notes
Switch between vertical/horizontal orientation and cards/scale looks
Parse years, months, days, BCE dates, and deep-time units (ka, Ma, Ga)
Show notes written as dated headings as timeline entries
Configure per-block options and plugin-wide defaults, in English or Japanese
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the interface and syntax support English and Japanese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn plain text in a note into a drawn timeline.

relations.evidence: The line syntax is compatible with Chronos Timeline (MIT), so existing Chronos-style lines can be pasted

summary: Timeline renderer that draws plain-text code blocks as vertical or horizontal timelines, as evenly spaced cards or to scale, with flexible date formats.
